meta.title: Add several products and delete a row before submitting the purchase intake

plan.title: Purchase Intake Row Add and Delete

args.goal: On the current purchase intake Product Details screen, fill a first product row with Product Name, Quantity, Unit of Measure, and Delivery Location; fill the next blank row with a second product; verify a new blank row is available after each addition; click the red bin icon for one product row; stop on the table showing only the kept product row(s) and the deleted row absent

steps.note: Performs and observes the product-row add and delete behavior, including the final table state.
Confirms the resulting intake screen has no rendering errors or invalid values.
